english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for surrounding land or an area with a wall, fence, or similar boundary.
Use this colloquial form when people or things physically close in around something, especially to keep it from getting away.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for surrounding or enclosing something.
Use 圍住 when something encircles or surrounds something else.

examples.english: Enclose the garden so the dogs cannot get out.
examples.traditional: 圍住個花園，唔畀啲狗走出去。

examples.english: The dogs surround the thief, so he cannot get away.
examples.traditional: 啲狗圍住個小偷，搞到佢走唔甩。
